1.why: Source pitch 1 (Remorse P1, mid-fifth-class broken blocks) ends at a ledge belay; 'good' dropped as unsupported
1.text: A ledge at the top of the broken, blocky ground that opens the climb.

2.why: Source pitch 2 (5.8) climbs cracks and traverses left to a ledge belay; flake detail removed as not confirmed
2.text: A ledge reached by traversing left after the short crack.

3.why: Source pitch 3 (5.7) ends on the ledge where Outer Space's own pitches start
3.text: The ledge above the chimney and blocks, where Outer Space itself begins.

5.why: Source pitch 5 (5.8): climb corner on right of pedestal, then belay on left side of pedestal
5.text: On the left side of the rock pedestal, after topping the corner on its right side.

6.why: Source pitch 6 (5.7+): hand crack from pedestal's left side, belay on a perfect ledge; 'roomy' reworded as unsupported
6.text: A ledge at the top of the long hand crack that starts from the pedestal's left side.

1.why: MP p1 5.10d: go left under roof clipping one bolt, belay is bolted; 'just left of' unsupported so removed
1.text: A bolted belay reached by traversing left beneath the big roof, clipping one bolt on the way.

5.why: MP pitch 5: went down and westward to gain snow and a belay in a moat; 'where snow meets rock' unsupported
5.text: In a moat on the snow, reached by going down and west from the notch.
